scope: K4 closure for three owner-selected pure transformation domains and preauthorized finite cycles; K5 ranking seam entry only.

V-K4-C01.limits: Finite retention remains; no unlimited storage, physical disk reclamation or long-term guarantee.

V-K4-C02.normal_baseline: Real same-input model calls, all 18 independently verified; not seeded broken implementations. Host oracle is independent of generated candidates.

V-K4-C03.primary_criterion: 6 correct samples, fewer repeated model calls after coding cost, latency/memory budgets
V-K4-C03.negative_action: Own active version disabled with recoverable package; unit fault injection verifies response. Token/monetary deltas are reported separately, not the primary promotion criterion.
V-K4-C03.limits: No user satisfaction or longitudinal benefit claim; group-counts costs more in this sample.

V-K4-C04.evidence: Live automatic stage/trial/promote/use; expired/revised/stopping/unknown/out-of-domain/budget tests; authorization rechecked in selection transactions and K3 checkpoints.

V-K4-C05.evidence: Real candidate loop + original-file preservation; failure/rejection/cancel/restart/idempotence regression; real HTTP/Edge lost-response recovery and concurrent synthetic chat; deployed data digests unchanged.

prior_probe.reason: Probe incorrectly treated newly delivered K3 report files as changes to original sources. Fixed to check every original byte plus absence of new Python files; final three cases passed. No production files involved.

configured_price_estimate_usd.basis: Configured provider prices, not an account invoice.

tests.initial_failure: One legacy migration assertion expected schema 6; updated to schema 7 while retaining all old-selection and idempotence assertions; final rerun passed.

checks: explicit contract and policy; rejected request can be corrected; actual committed request with lost reply reconciled once
parallel synthetic chat, cancellation, refresh receipt recovery and narrow viewport

ui_probe_fix: Exact text selector did not match multi-line chat bubbles; final probe requires two completed bubble responses and passed.

deployment.limits: One local calculator and personal-settings query; no paid model, microphone, task replay, persistent dialogue recovery or physical voice timing.

post_live_change: Final STOPPING-state authorization rejection tightened before final 32 tests and deployment; live matrix retains its earlier exact source binding.
